name: N8N Webhook Configuration Guide
description: Complete webhook payload structure for candidate acceptance and rejection workflows

candidate_acceptance.description: Triggered when a candidate is selected/accepted for an interview
candidate_acceptance.example_curl:
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/candidate-acceptance \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "candidateId": "cand_12345",
    "candidateName": "John Doe",
    "candidateEmail": "john.doe@example.com",
    "position": "Senior Software Engineer",
    "interviewDate": "2026-04-20",
    "interviewTime": "2:00 PM",
    "interviewDuration": 60,
    "timezone": "EST",
    "meetingLink": "https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij",
    "interviewerName": "Jane Smith",
    "hrEmail": "hr@company.com"
  }'

candidate_rejection.description: Triggered when a candidate is rejected

payload.feedbackSummary: Strong communication skills but lacking required technical background in machine learning

candidate_rejection.example_curl:
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/candidate-rejection \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "candidateId": "cand_67890",
    "candidateName": "Jane Smith",
    "candidateEmail": "jane.smith@example.com",
    "position": "Product Manager",
    "rejectionReason": "Did not meet technical requirements",
    "feedbackSummary": "Strong communication skills but lacking required technical background",
    "hrEmail": "hr@company.com",
    "allowReapply": true,
    "reapplyAfterMonths": 6
  }'

candidate_acceptance_workflow.name: Candidate Acceptance - Email & Meeting Link
steps: 1. Receive webhook with candidate and interview details
3. Generate professional acceptance email to candidate
4. Send HR notification email with full interview details
6. Log interview details for audit trail

emails_sent.subject: Interview Scheduled - [Position Name]
emails_sent.content: Professional html email with interview details, meeting link, and join button

emails_sent.subject: Interview Confirmation - [Candidate Name] ([Position])
emails_sent.content: HR notification with complete interview details for coordination

candidate_rejection_workflow.name: Candidate Rejection - Notification
steps: 3. Generate professional rejection email to candidate
4. Send HR notification with rejection record
6. Log rejection details for audit trail

emails_sent.subject: Application Update - [Position Name]
emails_sent.content: Professional rejection email with feedback, encouragement to reapply, and LinkedIn touch points

emails_sent.subject: Rejection Notification - [Candidate Name] ([Position])
emails_sent.content: HR record of rejection with reason, feedback, and reapply eligibility

rejection_email_variables.reapplyAfterMonths: Number of months before reapply eligibility
